subject.title: Redesign usage share card around model activity

question: Should CodexBar adopt this model-activity social-card contract as the intended bounded share artifact, including its priority over the existing provider-centric presentation?
rationale: The linked open design item explicitly requires maintainer product direction and broader state evidence; implementation quality alone cannot decide the visual information architecture.

options.title: Confirm the model-activity card contract
options.body: Approve this bounded model/source-focused direction, contingent on fresh-bundle export proof after the renderer dependency lands.

options.title: Request a narrower revision
options.body: Keep the current provider-centric story or specify which provider, spend, and activity details must remain visible before this redesign proceeds.

options.title: Defer the share-artifact redesign
options.body: Land only export correctness work now and revisit the presentation direction after the dashboard/share information architecture is decided.

recommendation.title: Confirm the model-activity card contract
recommendation.body: Approve this bounded model/source-focused direction, contingent on fresh-bundle export proof after the renderer dependency lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is repository-level product direction for a user-facing share artifact.
